natural: The peaks wind round and the path turns

meaning.en: A winding mountain path; also an unexpected turn for the better.
meaning.zh: 山势曲折，道路随着山势回环。也比喻事情经历曲折后出现转机。

examples.zh: 沿着山路走了半天，峰回路转，眼前出现一座小村庄。
examples.en: After hours on the winding mountain road, a small village suddenly came into view.

examples.zh: 案情峰回路转，嫌疑人竟然是无辜的。
examples.en: In a twist in the case, the suspect turned out to be innocent.

story.en: Ouyang Xiu's "Pavilion of the Old Drunkard": "the peaks wind round and the path turns, and there is a pavilion perched like wings over a spring".
story.zh: 欧阳修《醉翁亭记》："峰回路转，有亭翼然临于泉上者，醉翁亭也。"

usage.en: Predicate. Literal (scenery) or figurative (plots, situations).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可写景，也比喻转机。

natural: Hearing what one has never heard before

meaning.en: Unheard of; never heard of before.
meaning.zh: 听到了从来没有听到过的。形容事物新奇罕见。

equivalents: never heard of such a thing

examples.zh: 这种做法我真是闻所未闻。
examples.en: I've never heard of doing it that way.

examples.zh: 他讲了许多闻所未闻的奇闻趣事。
examples.en: He told lots of strange stories none of us had ever heard.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Often pairs with 见所未见.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常与"见所未见"连用。

natural: A fish that slipped through the net

meaning.en: Someone (usually a criminal) who has escaped capture.
meaning.zh: 从网眼里漏掉的鱼。比喻侥幸逃脱的罪犯或敌人。

examples.zh: 警方加大搜捕力度，不让一个漏网之鱼逃脱。
examples.en: The police stepped up the search so that no one would slip through the net.

examples.zh: 他是这次行动中唯一的漏网之鱼。
examples.en: He was the only one who got away in the operation.

usage.en: Noun phrase; subject or object.
usage.zh: 作主语、宾语。

natural: Riding the wind and breaking the waves

meaning.en: To forge boldly ahead despite difficulties.
meaning.zh: 船只乘着风势破浪前进。比喻排除困难，勇往直前。

examples.zh: 祝你在新的一年里乘风破浪，事业有成。
examples.en: May you forge ahead and succeed in the new year.

examples.zh: 这支年轻的团队乘风破浪，不断创新。
examples.en: The young team keeps forging ahead and innovating.

story.en: Asked as a boy what he wanted to be, Zong Que replied: "I wish to ride the long wind and break ten thousand li of waves" (愿乘长风破万里浪). He became a famous general. Li Bai later echoed it: 长风破浪会有时.
story.zh: 宗悫少时，叔父问其志，答曰："愿乘长风破万里浪。"李白亦有"长风破浪会有时"。

usage.en: Predicate. Common in good wishes and speeches. Also a popular TV-show title.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于祝福。

natural: Rising above one's kind and the crowd

meaning.en: Outstanding; head and shoulders above the rest.
meaning.zh: 超出同类之上。多指人的品德才能。

equivalents: head and shoulders above the rest

examples.zh: 她在同龄人中出类拔萃。
examples.en: She stands head and shoulders above her peers.

examples.zh: 这所学校培养了许多出类拔萃的人才。
examples.en: The school has produced many outstanding people.

story.en: Mencius says of Confucius that he "came forth from his kind and rose above the crowd" (出于其类，拔乎其萃) — no one since humanity began had surpassed him.
story.zh: 《孟子》："出于其类，拔乎其萃，自生民以来，未有盛于孔子也。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Praises people.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，称赞人。

natural: A thousand wounds and a hundred holes

meaning.en: Riddled with holes and defects; badly damaged.
meaning.zh: 形容破坏得很严重，或弊病很多。

examples.zh: 战争过后，这座城市千疮百孔。
examples.en: After the war, the city was in ruins.

examples.zh: 这套制度千疮百孔，必须改革。
examples.en: This system is riddled with flaws and must be reformed.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Also 百孔千疮.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。也作"百孔千疮"。

natural: Snorting at it through the nose

meaning.en: To sniff at; to treat with contempt.
meaning.zh: 用鼻子吭声冷笑。表示瞧不起。

examples.zh: 专家们对这种说法嗤之以鼻。
examples.en: Experts scoffed at the claim.

examples.zh: 他对名牌嗤之以鼻，只买实用的东西。
examples.en: He turns up his nose at brands and buys only practical things.

usage.en: Predicate, often 对……嗤之以鼻. 嗤 is chī.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"对……嗤之以鼻"。

natural: Brimming with the feeling of spring

meaning.en: Full of the life and atmosphere of spring.
meaning.zh: 形容春天的气氛很浓。

examples.zh: 三月的江南春意盎然。
examples.en: Southern China in March is bursting with spring.

examples.zh: 校园里春意盎然，到处是盛开的花。
examples.en: Spring is in the air on campus, with flowers blooming everywhere.

usage.en: Predicate. 盎 is àng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

natural: The man of Qi who feared the sky would fall

meaning.en: Needless worry; to worry about imaginary troubles.
meaning.zh: 比喻不必要的或缺乏根据的忧虑。

equivalents: cross that bridge when you come to it

examples.zh: 你担心飞机会掉下来，真是杞人忧天。
examples.en: Worrying the plane will fall out of the sky is needless worry.

examples.zh: 这并非杞人忧天，人口老龄化确实是个问题。
examples.en: This isn't needless worry — population ageing really is a problem.

story.en: A man of the state of Qi was so afraid the sky would fall and the earth collapse that he could neither eat nor sleep, until a friend explained that the sky was just air and the earth just soil.
story.zh: 杞国有人担心天塌地陷，以致寝食难安，后经人开导才放下心来。

usage.en: Predicate or object. Often negated: 并非杞人忧天.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常用"并非杞人忧天"。

natural: The thing goes back to its owner

meaning.en: To return something to its rightful owner.
meaning.zh: 把东西归还给原来的主人。

examples.zh: 出租车司机把乘客丢失的钱包物归原主。
examples.en: The taxi driver returned the passenger's lost wallet to its owner.

examples.zh: 这批流失海外的文物终于物归原主。
examples.en: The relics lost overseas have finally been returned to their rightful owner.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

literal: not · consider far · ten thousand · li
natural: Not counting ten thousand li as far

meaning.en: To travel a great distance without regard to how far it is.
meaning.zh: 不以万里为远。形容不怕路途遥远。

examples.zh: 他不远万里来到中国学习中医。
examples.en: He travelled halfway round the world to China to study Chinese medicine.

examples.zh: 感谢各位嘉宾不远万里前来参会。
examples.en: Thank you to all our guests who came so far to attend.

usage.en: Adverbial before verbs of coming. Formal and polite; common in speeches.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常用于致辞。

natural: Through the night until dawn

meaning.en: All night long, until dawn.
meaning.zh: 整整一夜，直到天亮。

examples.zh: 为了赶项目，他们通宵达旦地加班。
examples.en: They pulled an all-nighter to finish the project.

examples.zh: 除夕夜，很多人通宵达旦地守岁。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve, many people stay up all night.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。

natural: Like a fish finding water

meaning.en: In one's element; finding a congenial person or environment.
meaning.zh: 好像鱼得到水一样。比喻得到跟自己很投合的人或对自己很合适的环境。

examples.zh: 他换到销售部门后如鱼得水。
examples.en: He's in his element since moving to the sales department.

examples.zh: 她喜欢跟人打交道，当导游如鱼得水。
examples.en: She loves dealing with people and has taken to being a tour guide like a duck to water.

story.en: When Liu Bei's old companions grumbled about his closeness to Zhuge Liang, he said: "Having Kongming is like a fish having water" (孤之有孔明，犹鱼之有水也).
story.zh: 刘备说："孤之有孔明，犹鱼之有水也。"

usage.en: Predicate. About people in a suitable environment or partnership.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

natural: Coughing up one's heart and dripping blood

meaning.en: To pour one's heart and soul into work.
meaning.zh: 比喻费尽心思。多用于文艺创作或工作。

equivalents: pour one's heart and soul into

examples.zh: 这部小说是他呕心沥血十年的作品。
examples.en: This novel is the result of ten years of blood, sweat and tears.

examples.zh: 老师们为学生呕心沥血。
examples.en: The teachers pour their heart and soul into their students.

story.en: The poet Li He rode out daily jotting lines into a bag. His mother, seeing how full it was, said: "This boy won't stop until he coughs up his heart" (是儿要当呕出心乃已尔).
story.zh: 李贺每日骑驴觅句，投入锦囊。其母见囊中诗多，说："是儿要当呕出心乃已尔。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 血 is xuè here (also xiě in speech).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"血"读 xuè。

natural: Let go for a moment and it's gone

meaning.en: Fleeting; gone in an instant if not seized.
meaning.zh: 稍微一放松就消失了。形容时间或机会很容易失去。

examples.zh: 机会稍纵即逝，一定要抓住。
examples.en: Opportunities are fleeting — you must seize them.

examples.zh: 灵感稍纵即逝，他随身带着笔记本。
examples.en: Inspiration vanishes in an instant, so he carries a notebook.

origin.source: 宋·苏轼《文与可画筼筜谷偃竹记》

story.en: Su Shi, describing his friend's bamboo painting, said one must paint the moment the image appears, "like a falcon swooping on a rising hare — relax a little and it's gone" (少纵则逝矣).
story.zh: 苏轼论画竹："急起从之，振笔直遂，以追其所见，如兔起鹘落，少纵则逝矣。"

usage.en: Predicate. Opportunities, inspiration, time.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指机会、灵感。

natural: A thousand jun hanging by one hair

meaning.en: A critical moment; hanging by a thread.
meaning.zh: 千钧重的东西挂在一根头发上。比喻情况万分危急。

examples.zh: 在这千钧一发之际，消防员冲进火场救出了孩子。
examples.en: At the critical moment, a firefighter rushed in and saved the child.

examples.zh: 列车在千钧一发之时刹住了车。
examples.en: The train braked in the nick of time.

story.en: Han Yu wrote that Confucianism in his time was "as perilous as a thousand jun hung from a single hair" (其危如一发引千钧).
story.zh: 韩愈《与孟尚书书》："其危如一发引千钧。"

usage.en: Usually 千钧一发之际/之时 (at the critical moment). 钧 = 30 jin; 发 is fà (hair).
usage.zh: 常用"千钧一发之际"。"发"读 fà。

natural: Rousing oneself to become strong

meaning.en: To work hard to make oneself (or one's country) strong.
meaning.zh: 振作精神，努力谋求强盛。

examples.zh: 失败后，他奋发图强，最终考上了研究生。
examples.en: After failing, he worked doubly hard and eventually got into graduate school.

examples.zh: 这个民族奋发图强，摆脱了贫困。
examples.en: Through determined effort, the nation lifted itself out of poverty.

usage.en: Predicate. Formal and motivating.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面、勉励色彩。

natural: Planning strategy inside the command tent

meaning.en: To devise strategy from headquarters; masterful planning.
meaning.zh: 指在后方决定作战策略。泛指策划机要。

examples.zh: 教练运筹帷幄，球队赢得了冠军。
examples.en: With the coach masterminding the tactics, the team won the title.

examples.zh: 她在总部运筹帷幄，指挥全国的销售。
examples.en: She directs sales across the country from headquarters.

story.en: Liu Bang, founder of Han, praised his adviser Zhang Liang: "Planning in the command tent and deciding victory a thousand li away — in this I am not Zifang's equal."
story.zh: 刘邦说："夫运筹策帷帐之中，决胜于千里之外，吾不如子房。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often paired with 决胜千里. 帷幄 is wéiwò.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"决胜千里"连用。

natural: Rich in both voice and feeling

meaning.en: (Of a performance) with fine voice and deep feeling.
meaning.zh: 声音和感情都很丰富动人。多形容演唱、朗诵。

examples.zh: 她声情并茂地朗诵了一首诗。
examples.en: She recited a poem with great feeling.

examples.zh: 这场演出声情并茂，感动了观众。
examples.en: The heartfelt performance moved the audience.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. Singing, reciting, speeches.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语。

natural: Holding the troops back without moving

meaning.en: To hold back and wait; to take no action for now.
meaning.zh: 使军队暂不行动。现也比喻接受任务后不肯行动，或暂时观望。

examples.zh: 在形势明朗之前，我们先按兵不动。
examples.en: Until the situation is clearer, we'll sit tight.

examples.zh: 多数投资者按兵不动，等待政策出台。
examples.en: Most investors are holding fire until the policy is announced.

usage.en: Predicate. Can be strategic or criticise inaction.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可指策略性等待，也批评不行动。

natural: Shoulders rubbing and heels touching

meaning.en: Shoulder to shoulder; extremely crowded.
meaning.zh: 肩碰肩，脚碰脚。形容人很多，很拥挤。

examples.zh: 节假日的步行街上游客摩肩接踵。
examples.en: On holidays the pedestrian street is packed shoulder to shoulder.

examples.zh: 庙会上人们摩肩接踵，热闹非凡。
examples.en: At the temple fair people were packed in, and it was incredibly lively.

usage.en: Predicate. 踵 is zhǒng (heel).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"踵"读 zhǒng。

natural: Glaring like a tiger

meaning.en: To eye greedily; watching menacingly, ready to pounce.
meaning.zh: 像老虎那样凶狠地盯着。形容贪婪地注视着，伺机攫取。

examples.zh: 竞争对手对这个市场虎视眈眈。
examples.en: Rivals are eyeing this market greedily.

examples.zh: 几个大公司都对这家初创企业虎视眈眈。
examples.en: Several big companies are circling the start-up, waiting to pounce.

story.en: The Book of Changes: "The tiger looks with a fixed glare, its desire unceasing" (虎视眈眈，其欲逐逐).

usage.en: Predicate, often 对……虎视眈眈. 眈 is dān.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"对……虎视眈眈"。

natural: Wilting and unable to rally

meaning.en: Listless and dispirited; sluggish.
meaning.zh: 形容精神颓丧，不能振作。也指经济等不景气。

examples.zh: 他失业后整天萎靡不振。
examples.en: Since losing his job he's been listless all day.

examples.zh: 房地产市场萎靡不振。
examples.en: The property market is in the doldrums.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. People or markets. 靡 is mǐ.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，可指人或市场。"靡"读 mǐ。

natural: Standing alone on the turtle's head

meaning.en: To come first; to top the list.
meaning.zh: 原指科举考试中状元及第。后比喻占首位或第一名。

examples.zh: 这部电影在票房榜上独占鳌头。
examples.en: The film is top of the box office charts.

examples.zh: 他在全市数学竞赛中独占鳌头。
examples.en: He took first place in the city maths competition.

usage.en: Predicate. In imperial palaces, the top exam candidate stood on the carved head of the giant turtle (鳌) on the palace steps.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。旧时皇宫石阶上刻有巨鳌，状元站在鳌头上迎榜。

natural: From ancient times to the present

meaning.en: Throughout history; from ancient times to now.
meaning.zh: 从古到今。

examples.zh: 古往今来，多少英雄为国捐躯。
examples.en: Throughout history, countless heroes have died for their country.

examples.zh: 古往今来，爱情都是文学的永恒主题。
examples.en: Through the ages, love has been literature's eternal theme.

usage.en: Usually an opening adverbial. Common in essays.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常用于句首。作文常用。
